title: Everything You Need To Know About Comrades Marathon
claims: The article says the Comrades course is famous for its "Big Five" hills, climbed in order on the Up Run: Cowies Hill, Field's Hill, Botha's Hill, Inchanga and Polly Shortts.
It says Polly Shortts sits at about the 80 km mark on the Up Run and is the last climb of the day in that direction.
It describes the route as following the N3 corridor through Westville, Pinetown, Kloof, Hillcrest, Drummond, Cato Ridge and Camperdown.
It states that the race alternates direction each year, so the Down Run reverses the Up Run order.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取 Marathon Handbook 2026-06-13 文章。该文不是赛事官方页面，只用于五大坡名称与顺序；正文明确标注“官网未单列 Big Five 页面”。
